description: FUNCTION LOCALE-COMPARE (ISO 15.51), LOCALE-DATE (15.52) and LOCALE-TIME (15.53) - the locale-based comparison returning '<' / '=' / '>' (15.51.4 r5/r6) over the named locale's (else the current LC_COLLATE's) cultural ordering, and the culturally formatted date and time per the locale's d_fmt / t_fmt (15.52.4 r2, 15.53.4 r2; DETERMINATION L10: the culture's short date / long time patterns). LIVE (kb/Work PB64 T4): CobolLocale.Compare / Date / Time over the ONE LocaleCollation carrier and LocaleFacts; the optional locale-name-1 is a SPECIAL-NAMES LOCALE clause's name (COBOL1664 otherwise). Below 2002 the D8 catalog window rejects by name+edition (COBOL1502) - the window is enforced now that the rows' Bind is Runtime (it was suppressed while they were Unsupported). THE EDGE IS QUOTED from the edition texts (kb/Work PB3965): the 1985 standard's intrinsic functions are those of its 1989 amendment, whose list runs from 'The LENGTH function returns' (§1989:A.2.19.1) straight to 'The LOG function returns' (§1989:A.2.20.1), with no LOCALE- function between them; 2002 adds the three, 'The LOCALE-COMPARE function returns a character indicating the result of comparing argument-1 and argument-2' (§2002:15.40), 'The LOCALE-DATE function returns a character string containing a date in a culturally-appropriate format' (§2002:15.41) and 'The LOCALE-TIME function returns a character string containing a time in a culturally-appropriate format' (§2002:15.42), and §2002:F.2 states the change, its item 78, 'New intrinsic functions are' a table holding LOCALE-COMPARE, LOCALE-DATE and LOCALE-TIME, and its item 42: 'Cultural adaptability and multilingual support. Support is provided for using local conventions'. 2014 keeps them (§2014:15.47, §2014:15.48, §2014:15.49) and makes the locale facility optional, a feature 'required in the previous COBOL standard' (§2014:E.2 item 23, its list naming 'A.4.8, Locale support and related functions'); §2023:15.51.1, §2023:15.52.1 and §2023:15.53.1 carry the 2002 sentences (kb/Work R28).
vcr: 2002 introduction (the locale facility's functions; §2002:F.2 items 42 and 78)

IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. PB64T4F.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
CONFIGURATION SECTION.
SPECIAL-NAMES.
    LOCALE FR IS "fr-FR".
DATA DIVISION.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 R PIC X.
01 S PIC X(20).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    MOVE FUNCTION LOCALE-COMPARE("a" "b" FR) TO R.
    MOVE FUNCTION LOCALE-DATE("20260819") TO S.
    MOVE FUNCTION LOCALE-TIME("130509" FR) TO S.
    STOP RUN.
